own_solution.law: Projectile motion: t = sqrt(2h/g), x = v t
assumptions: horizontal launch at height of thrower's standing spot

notes: Base: t = sqrt(40/9.8) = 2.0203 s, x = 30.305 m. Thrower on a 14 m platform: h = 34 m, t = sqrt(68/9.8) = 2.6342 s, x = 39.512 m (the problem's clause that the stone leaves at the level of the thrower's standing spot makes the platform add to h). Mass enters m a = m g and cancels (C). Earlier experiment and surveyor's platform have no path (D). TFC1C and TE4A5 carry 'a few metres' rather than 14 m (appear to be number-free variants).
